statements.impact_statement: grpc-go bundled fixes for an xDS RBAC authorization-bypass/panic (internal/xds/rbac) and an HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DoS on the server transport. grpc was owned as an indirect dep by the docker-agent fork; rebasing that fork onto upstream v1.118.0 bumped grpc 1.81.1 -> 1.82.1 (the fixed version), so the finding is resolved. It was never reachable in the first place (client-transport-only, no xDS, no grpc server; govulncheck 0 reachable) — see the prior not_affected disposition in git history.

The advisory flags golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp as unmaintained and unsafe by design; it has no fixed version. x/crypto is an indirect dependency of the turf CLI and only the openpgp subpackage is affected. Both govulncheck and osv-scanner call-analysis report no call path from any turf entrypoint to x/crypto/openpgp — it is imported-but-not-called. Re-review if a dependency (or first-party code) ever calls into x/crypto/openpgp.
